parts.text:
Create a unique premium visual design direction for an Instagram testimonial background.

Service: {{2.service}}
Review: {{2.review_text}}

Determine the overall background theme based on the service and review.

Return the first line EXACTLY as one of:
THEME: LIGHT
THEME: DARK

Then provide the visual design direction.

Choose a sophisticated color palette, background treatment, visual elements, lighting, texture, composition, and mood that fit the service and review.

Keep the design premium, polished, and visually varied between requests. Avoid repeatedly using the same color palette, gradient, background treatment, or decorative style.

For LIGHT themes:
- Use refined light-to-medium tones, not pure white.
- Maintain enough contrast for dark testimonial text.

For DARK themes:
- Use rich dark-to-medium tones, not pure black.
- Maintain enough contrast for white testimonial text.

Keep the entire top portion visually empty and uncluttered because the rating graphic will be added separately later.

Do not include, suggest, mention, or describe stars, ratings, quotation marks, testimonial graphics, typography, logos, words, letters, numbers, icons, charts, graphs, progress bars, dots, markers, or any other decorative elements intended to represent a rating or testimonial.

Generate ONLY:
1. The THEME line
2. The visual style direction for the background

Do not explain your decision.

mapper.text:
Create a professional 4:5 portrait background graphic for an Instagram Feed testimonial post (1080x1350).
Visual direction from Gemini:
{{52.candidates[].content.parts[].text}}
Fixed requirements:
- Leave a large, completely clean negative-space area in the center and lower portion for text to be added separately.
- Keep the entire top portion of the image completely empty and uncluttered — no elements of any kind should appear there.
- The background must contain ZERO stars or star-shaped graphics.
- Do not generate star icons, star motifs, rating symbols, sparkle stars, or star-shaped decorative elements.
- Do not render any icons, symbols, charts, graphs, progress bars, dots, markers, or line-with-marker imagery of any kind.
- Do not render any words, letters, numbers, logos, fake text, or text-like elements.
- Do not add decorative typography or background text.
- Maintain strong contrast in the text area so either dark or white text can be added later.
Service context: {{2.service}}
Use the service context and Gemini's visual direction to determine the visual style, colors, imagery, lighting, texture, composition, and mood of the background.
The final background should look polished, premium, and visually varied between requests, while keeping the reserved areas completely empty for elements to be layered on separately afterward.
